42300.meaning1: and for the venerable; and of the venerable

examples.text: so ce dūto taṃ bhikkhuṃ evaṃ vadeyya, atthi pan'āyasmato koci veyyāvaccakaro'ti. cīvar'atthikena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā veyyāvaccakaro niddisitabbo ārāmiko vā upāsako vā, eso kho, āvuso, bhikkhūnaṃ veyyāvaccakaro'ti.
tañ'ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuṃ pare evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, ke pan'āyasmato ākārā, ke anvayā, yen'āyasmā evaṃ vadesi, sammāsambuddho bhagavā, svākkhāto bhagavatā dhammo, suppaṭipanno saṅgho'ti?

42301.commentary: (MNa) kathañ'ca pan'āyasmantan'ti idaṃ pana thero sammodamāno āha.

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ puṇṇaṃ mantāṇiputtaṃ etadavoca, konāmo āyasmā, kathañ'ca pan'āyasmantaṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī'ti? puṇṇo'ti kho me, āvuso, nāmaṃ, mantāṇiputto'ti ca pana maṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī'ti.
ko nāmo āyasmā, kathañ'ca pan'āyasmantaṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī'ti?
sampajānamusāvādo kho pan'āyasmanto antarāyiko dhammo vutto bhagavatā, tasmā saramānena bhikkhunā āpannena visuddh'āpekkhena santī āpatti āvikātabbā, āvikatā hi'ssa phāsu hoti.
ime kho pan'āyasmanto dve aniyatā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti abbhaññāsi. aññataro ca pan'āyasmā soṇo arahataṃ ahosi.
idaṃ pan'āyasmā, kattha vuttaṃ bhagavatā'ti, iti puṭṭho na sampāyissati.
kāmaṃ kho pana m'āhu paro loko, hotu nesaṃ bhavataṃ samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ saccaṃ vacanaṃ, atha ca pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ gārayho
atha ca pan'āyaṃ bhavaṃ purisapuggalo diṭṭh'eva dhamme viññūnaṃ gārayho, dussīlo purisapuggalo micchādiṭṭhi n'atthikavādo'ti

42305.synonym: kaliggaha, byaya, vaya, vighāta, vināsa, virāga, vyaya

examples.text: lābhī acchādana-vattha-mokkhapāvuraṇānaṃ, bhavati yadi anāgāriyataṃ upeti, sahito purimakataphalaṃ anubhavati, na bhavati katassa panāso'ti.

42306.meaning1: and they could be; or they may be

examples.text: yassa ca pana me bhāsitassa atthaṃ na ājāneyyātha, ahaṃ vo tattha paṭipucchitabbo, ye vā pan'āssu viyattā bhikkhū.

42307.meaning1: and friend; and what's more brothers

examples.text: neyyaṃ pan'āvuso, dhammaṃ kena pajānātī'ti? neyyaṃ kho, āvuso, dhammaṃ paññācakkhunā pajānātī'ti.
yasmiṃ pan'āvuso, samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjh'aṅgānaṃ akālo bhāvanāya, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjh'aṅgānaṃ kālo bhāvanāyā'ti?

42308.meaning1: but I; then I; and I

examples.text: n'āhaṃ, moggallāna, sabbeh'eva saṃsaggaṃ vaṇṇayāmi na pan'āhaṃ, moggallāna, sabbeh'eva saṃsaggaṃ na vaṇṇayāmi
aññāya ca pan'āhaṃ samaṇānaṃ sakyaputtikānaṃ dhammaṃ ev'āhaṃ tasmā dhammavinayā apakkanto'ti?
taṃ kho pan'idaṃ dukkhasamudayaṃ ariyasaccaṃ pahātabban'ti

42313.meaning1: and here a certain; but here some
42313.meaning2: and here a certain; but here some

examples.text: samaṇo gotamo pāpito bhavissatī'ti bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, brāhmaṇo, bho gotama, pokkharasāti opamañño subhagavaniko evam'āha, evam'eva pan'idh'ekacce samaṇabrāhmaṇā uttarimanussadhammā alam'ariya-ñāṇadassana-visesaṃ paṭijānanti.
sant'etth'ekacce bhikkhū samma'd'eva aññaṃ byākaṃsu, santi pan'idh'ekacce bhikkhū adhimānena'pi aññaṃ byākaṃsu.

42314.meaning1: and of this; and about this

examples.text: kiṃ pan'imassa mattaṭṭhakassa kāyassa taṇh'upādinnassa ahan'ti vā maman'ti vā asmī'ti vā? atha khv'āssa no't'ev'ettha hoti.
evam'eva kho, māgaṇḍiya, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā andhā acakkhukā ajānantā ārogyaṃ, apassantā nibbānaṃ, atha ca pan'imaṃ gāthaṃ bhāsanti
cha kho pan'imāni, āvuso, ajjhattikabāhirāni āyatanāni tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena samma'd'akkhātāni. katamāni cha?
cuddasa kho pan'imāni yonipamukhasatasahassāni saṭṭhi ca satāni cha ca satāni, pañca ca kammuno satāni pañca ca kammāni tīṇi ca kammāni, kamme ca aḍḍhakamme ca

yo pana bhikkhu pātimokkhe uddissamāne evaṃ vadeyya, kiṃ pan'imehi khudd'ānukhuddakehi sikkhāpadehi uddiṭṭhehi, yāva'd'eva kukkuccāya vihesāya vilekhāya saṃvattantī'ti, sikkhāpadavivaṇṇake pācittiyaṃ.

42318.meaning1: dispelling; driving out; rejecting; pushing away

examples.text: papañcasaññā itar'ītarā narā, papañcayantā upayanti saññino, manomayaṃ gehasitañ'ca sabbaṃ, panujja nekkhammasitaṃ irīyati.
yaṃ kiñci sampajānāsi, uddhaṃ adho tiriyañ'cā'pi majjhe, etesu nandiñ'ca nivesanañ'ca, panujja viññāṇaṃ bhave na tiṭṭhe.

42319.meaning1: being driven away; being expelled; being forced away
42319.commentary: (MNa) api panujjamānenā'pī'ti api nikkaḍḍhīyamānen'āpi. evarūpo hi puggalo sace'pi dārukalāpasataṃ vā udakaghaṭasataṃ vā vālikambaṇasataṃ vā daṇḍaṃ āharāpeti, mā idha vasī'ti nikkaḍḍhāpeti vā, taṃ taṃ khamāpetvā yāvajīvaṃ vatthabbam'evā'ti.

examples.text: tena, bhikkhave, bhikkhunā yāvajīvam'pi so puggalo anubandhitabbo, na pakkamitabbaṃ, api panujjamānena'pī'ti.

42320.meaning1: driven out; dispelled; sent away; dispatched

examples.text: yamhī na māyā vasatī na māno, yo vītalobho amamo nirāso, panuṇṇakodho abhinibbut'atto, so brāhmaṇo so samaṇo sa bhikkhū'ti.

42321.commentary: (ANa) panuṇṇapaccekasacco'ti idam'eva dassanaṃ saccaṃ, idam'eva saccan'ti evaṃ pāṭiekkaṃ gahitattā paccekasaṅkhātāni diṭṭhisaccāni panuṇṇāni nīhaṭāni pahīnāni assā'ti panuṇṇapaccekasacco.

examples.text: panuṇṇapaccekasacco, bhikkhave, bhikkhu samavayasaṭṭh'esano passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro patilīno'ti vuccati. kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhu panuṇṇapaccekasacco hoti?

42322.meaning1: dispels; drives out; rejects; pushes away

nindāya nappavedheyya, na uṇṇameyya pasaṃsito bhikkhu, lobhaṃ saha macchariyena, kodhaṃ pesuṇiyañ'ca panudeyya.

42326.synonym: apanudi, apānudi, ahāsi, byapānudi, vinodayi, vinodi, vinodesi

examples.text: avivādavaḍḍhanakariṃ sugiraṃ, bhinn'ānusandhijananiṃ abhaṇi, kalahaṃ janassa panudī samaṅgī, sahitehi nandati pamodati ca.
daddallamānā āgañchuṃ, taṇhā ca aratī ragā, tā tattha panudī satthā, tūlaṃ bhaṭṭhaṃ'va māluto'ti.

42329.meaning2: having dispelled, having removed, having pushed away

examples.text: tass'ovādakarā bahugihī ca pabbajitā ca, asuciṃ garahitaṃ dhunanti pāpaṃ, sa hi sucibhi parivuto bhavati, mala-khila-kali-kilese panudehī'ti.

42332.commentary: (VISMa) evaṃ passanto tarupaṇṇāni paccakkhato eva niccasaññaṃ panūdati pajahati, aniccasaññā evassa saṇṭhāti.

examples.text: chinda sotaṃ parakkamma, kāme panūda brāhmaṇa, nappahāya munī kāme, n'ekattam'upapajjati.
abhirattāni nīlāni, paṇḍūni patitāni ca, passanto tarupaṇṇāni, niccasaññaṃ panūdati.

42333.meaning1: dispelling; driving out; forcing out; eviction

examples.text: pahānaṃ kāmacchandānaṃ, domanassāna c'ūbhayaṃ, thinassa ca panūdanaṃ, kukkuccānaṃ nivāraṇaṃ.
kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, atidhāvanti eke? bhaven'eva kho pan'eke aṭṭīyamānā harāyamānā jigucchamānā vibhavaṃ abhinandanti
ettāvat'aggam'pi vadanti h'eke, yakkhassa suddhiṃ idha paṇḍitāse, tesaṃ pan'eke samayaṃ vadanti, anupādisese kusalā vadānā.
ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekacco purisapuggalo lok'āmis'ādhimutto assa.
ataramāno'va bhāseyya no taramāno'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ?
atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, ke pan'ete, ānanda, uccāsaddā mahāsaddā, kevaṭṭā maññe macchavilope'ti?

42337.meaning1: and here; and in this regard
42337.commentary: (MNa) yo vā pan'ettha dhammo'ti yo vā pana ettha dhammo sabhāvo, tass'eva vā adassanena.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho ghoṭamukho brāhmaṇo āyasmantaṃ udenaṃ etadavoca, ambho samaṇa, n'atthi dhammiko paribbajo, evaṃ me ettha hoti. tañ'ca kho bhavantarūpānaṃ vā adassanā, yo vā pan'ettha dhammo'ti.

ayaṃ pan'ettha saṅkhepo, bhagavato kira bhikkhusaṅghassa ca pañcannaṃ mahānadīnaṃ mah'oghasadise lābhasakkāre uppanne hatalābhasakkārā aññatitthiyā sūriy'uggamanakāle khajjopanakā viya nippabhā hutvā ekato sannipatitvā mantayiṃsu.

examples.text: sā kho pan'esā, bhikkhave, taṇhā kattha uppajjamānā uppajjati, kattha nivisamānā nivisati? yaṃ loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati.
sā kho pan'esā, mahānāma, brahmunā sanaṅkumārena gāthā sugītā no duggītā, subhāsitā no dubbhāsitā, atthasaṃhitā no anatthasaṃhitā, anumatā bhagavatā'ti.
yā uṇṇatī s'āssa vighātabhūmi, mān'ātimānaṃ vadate pan'eso, etam'pi disvā na vivādayetha, na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti.
bhikkhu pan'eva dubbacajātiko hoti uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu bhikkhūhi sahadhammikaṃ vuccamāno attānaṃ avacanīyaṃ karoti
niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kathine bhikkhuno pan'eva akālacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, ākaṅkhamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭiggahetvā khippam'eva kāretabbaṃ
etha tumhe, āvuso, āraññikā hotha, araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni paṭisevathā'ti, iti kāyavūpakāse samādapetabbā nivesetabbā patiṭṭhāpetabbā
katī parissayā loke, gacchato agataṃ disaṃ, ye bhikkhu abhisambhave, pantamhi sayan'āsane.

(UDa) pantañ'ca sayan'āsanan'ti vivittaṃ saṅghaṭṭanavirahitaṃ sen'āsanaṃ (UDa) pantañ'ca sayan'āsanan'ti bhāvan'ānukūlaṃ arañña-rukkhamūl'ādi-vivitta-sen'āsanaṃ. (SNPa) pantañ'ca sayan'āsanaṃ, vivittaṃ appanigghosan'ti yañ'ca sayan'āsanaṃ pantaṃ dūraṃ vivittaṃ appākiṇṇaṃ appanigghosaṃ, yattha migasūkar'ādisaddena araññasaññā uppajjati, tathārūpaṃ sayan'āsanañ'ca bhajassu.

paññaṃ purakkhatvā kalyāṇapīti, vikkhambhaye tāni parissayāni, aratiṃ sahetha sayanamhi pante, caturo sahetha paridevadhamme.

42370.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of pannarasa
42370.meaning1: on the fifteenth day of the lunar fortnight

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā tadah'uposathe pannarase puṇṇāya puṇṇamāya rattiyā bhikkhusaṅghaparivuto abbhokāse nisinno hoti.
idh'ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa tadah'uposathe pannarase sīsaṃ nhātassa uposathikassa uparipāsādavaragatassa dibbaṃ cakkaratanaṃ pāturahosi sahass'āraṃ sanemikaṃ sanābhikaṃ sabbākāraparipūraṃ.

42371.meaning2: whose hairs have fallen; i.e. subdued

examples.text: ye ca bhikkhū sikkhākāmā te taṃ pahāya app'ossukkā pannalomā paradattavuttā migabhūtena cetasā viharanti.

42373.commentary: (JAa) papaṃ avindun'ti udakaṃ paṭilabhiṃsu. udakañ'hi papīyanabhāvena papā'ti vuccati. pavaddhaṃ vā āpaṃ papaṃ, mah'odakan'ti attho.

examples.text: akilāsuno vaṇṇ'upathe khaṇantā, udaṅgaṇe tattha papaṃ avinduṃ, evaṃ munī vīriya bal'ūpapanno, akilāsu vinde hadayassa santin'ti.

42374.meaning2: obstacle, impediment, delay, illusion, hindrance to spiritual progress

examples.text: nippapañc'ārāmass'āyaṃ dhammo nippapañcaratino n'āyaṃ dhammo papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino'ti
yo n'āccasārī na paccasārī, sabbaṃ accagamā imaṃ papañcaṃ, so bhikkhu jahāti orapāraṃ, urago jiṇṇam'iva tacaṃ purāṇaṃ.

42376.meaning1: ending of mental proliferation; cessation of endless conceptualization

examples.text: channaṃ, āvuso, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā papañcanirodho papañcavūpasamo'ti.

42377.meaning1: indulging in various opinions; engaged in mental proliferation; devoted to endless conceptualization
42377.commentary: (THa) yo papañcamanuyutto'ti yo pana puggalo kamm'ārāmat'ādi-vasena rūp'ābhisaṅg'ādi-vasena ca pavattiyā papañcan'aṭṭhena taṇh'ādi-bhedaṃ papañcaṃ anuyutto, tattha ca anādīnavadassanena abhirato magasadiso, so nibbānaṃ virādhayi, so nibbānā suvidūravidūre ṭhito.

42378.meaning1: proliferating; making manifold; forming various opinions (about)

examples.text: papañcasaññā itar'ītarā narā, papañcayantā upayanti saññino, manomayaṃ gehasitañ'ca sabbaṃ, panujja nekkhammasitaṃ irīyati.

42379.meaning1: taking pleasure in mental proliferation; addicted to manifold ideas

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu… saṅgaṇik'ārāmo hoti saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇik'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, saṃsagg'ārāmo hoti saṃsaggarato saṃsagg'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, papañc'ārāmo hoti papañcarato papañc'ārāmataṃ anuyutto.

42380.meaning1: taking pleasure in mental proliferation; addicted to manifold ideas

examples.text: sā pan'āvuso, niṭṭhā papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino udāhu nippapañc'ārāmassa nippapañcaratino'ti? sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, nippapañc'ārāmass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā nippapañcaratino, na sā niṭṭhā papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino'ti.
nippapañc'ārāmass'āyaṃ dhammo nippapañcaratino n'āyaṃ dhammo papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino'ti

42381.commentary: (SNPa) saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā'ti evaṃ paṭipannass'āpi yā saññā, tan'nidānā taṇhādiṭṭhipapañcā appahīnā eva hontī'ti dasseti. (SNPa) papañcā'ti saṅkhātattā papañcā eva papañcasaṅkhā.

examples.text: na saññasaññī na visaññasaññī, no'pi asaññī na vibhūtasaññī, evaṃ sametassa vibhoti rūpaṃ, saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā.
mūlaṃ papañcasaṅkhāya, mantā asmī'ti sabbam'uparundhe, yā kāci taṇhā ajjhattaṃ, tāsaṃ vinayā sadā sato sikkhe.

42382.meaning1: with a proliferation of opinions; full of diverse concepts

examples.text: papañcasaññā itar'ītarā narā, papañcayantā upayanti saññino, manomayaṃ gehasitañ'ca sabbaṃ, panujja nekkhammasitaṃ irīyati.

42383.meaning1: proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs; (or) classification of diverse perceptions
42383.commentary: (DNa) papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno'ti tayo papañcā taṇhāpapañco, mānapapañco, diṭṭhipapañco'ti. tattha aṭṭhasatataṇhāvicaritaṃ taṇhāpapañco nāma. navavidho māno mānapapañco nāma. dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhiyo diṭṭhipapañco nāma. (MNa) papañcasaññāsaṅkhā'ti ettha saṅkhā'ti koṭṭhāso. papañcasaññā'ti taṇhā-māna-diṭṭhi-papañca-sampayuttā saññā, saññānāmena vā papañcāy'eva vuttā. tasmā papañcakoṭṭhāsā'ti ayam'ettha attho. samudācarantī'ti pavattanti.
42383.notes: An ambigious compound which defies clear translation. Bhikkhu Bodhi: 'perceptions and notions born of mental proliferation'. Cone: 'the group of perceptions of manifoldness, diversity;?', Ṭhānissaro: 'perceptions and categories of objectification', Sujato: 'concepts of identity (that emerge from) the proliferation of perceptions'.

examples.text: yatonidānaṃ, bhikkhu, purisaṃ papañcasaññāsaṅkhā samudācaranti. ettha ce n'atthi abhinanditabbaṃ abhivaditabbaṃ ajjhositabbaṃ.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. tena kho pana samayena bhagavā attano papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpahānaṃ paccavekkhamāno nisinno hoti.

42384.meaning1: born from the proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs

examples.text: vitakko kho, devānam'inda, papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno papañcasaññāsaṅkhāsamudayo papañcasaññāsaṅkhājātiko papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpabhavo, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya sati vitakko hoti, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya asati vitakko na hotī'ti.

42385.meaning1: having the proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs as origin
42385.commentary: (DNa) papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno'ti tayo papañcā taṇhāpapañco, mānapapañco, diṭṭhipapañco'ti. tattha aṭṭhasatataṇhāvicaritaṃ taṇhāpapañco nāma. navavidho māno mānapapañco nāma. dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhiyo diṭṭhipapañco nāma. tesu idha taṇhāpapañco adhippeto. ken'aṭṭhena papañco? mattapamatt'ākāra-pāpan'aṭṭhena papañco. taṃsampayuttā saññā papañcasaññā. saṅkhā vuccati koṭṭhāso saññānidānā hi papañcasaṅkhā'ti-ādīsu viya. iti papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno'ti papañcasaññākoṭṭhāsanidāno vitakko'ti attho. (DNt) saṅkhā vuccati koṭṭhāso bhāgaso saṅkhāyati upaṭṭhātī'ti. yasmā papañcasaññā taṃtaṃdvāravasena, ārammaṇavasena ca bhāgaso vitakkassa paccayā honti, na kevalā, tasmā papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno vitakko vutto, papañcasaññānaṃ vā anekabhedabhinnattā taṃsamudāyo papañcasaññāsaṅkhā'ti vutto. papañcasaññāsaṅkhāggahaṇena ca anavaseso dukkhasamudayo vutto taṃtaṃ nimittattā vaṭṭadukkhassā'ti.

examples.text: vitakko kho, devānam'inda, papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno papañcasaññāsaṅkhāsamudayo papañcasaññāsaṅkhājātiko papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpabhavo, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya sati vitakko hoti, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya asati vitakko na hotī'ti.

42386.meaning1: suitable for leading to the end of the proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs
42386.commentary: (DNa) papañcasaññāsaṅkhā-nirodhasāruppagāminin'ti etissā papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya khayā nirodho vūpasamo, tassa sāruppañ'c'eva tattha gāminiṃ cā'ti saha vipassanāya maggaṃ pucchati. (DNa) evaṃ paṭipanno kho, devānam'inda, bhikkhu papañcasaññāsaṅkhā-nirodhasāruppagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hotī'ti bhagavā arahattanikūṭena desanaṃ niṭṭhapesi.
42386.sanskrit: prapañca + saṃjñā + saṃkhyā + nirodha + sārūpya + gāmin

examples.text: kathaṃ paṭipanno pana, mārisa, bhikkhu papañcasaññāsaṅkhā-nirodhasāruppagāminiṃ paṭipadaṃ paṭipanno hotī'ti?

42387.meaning1: produced by the proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs

examples.text: vitakko kho, devānam'inda, papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno papañcasaññāsaṅkhāsamudayo papañcasaññāsaṅkhājātiko papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpabhavo, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya sati vitakko hoti, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya asati vitakko na hotī'ti.

42388.meaning1: with the proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs as source

examples.text: vitakko kho, devānam'inda, papañcasaññāsaṅkhānidāno papañcasaññāsaṅkhāsamudayo papañcasaññāsaṅkhājātiko papañcasaññāsaṅkhāpabhavo, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya sati vitakko hoti, papañcasaññāsaṅkhāya asati vitakko na hotī'ti.

42389.meaning1: concept of being overwhelmed by a proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs; what is called being overwhelmed by a proliferation of opinions, concepts and constructs
42389.commentary: (MNa) phassapaññattiṃ paññapessatī'ti phasso nāma eko dhammo uppajjatī'ti evaṃ phassapaññattiṃ paññapessati, dassessatī'ti attho. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: saññāpaññattiyā sati vitakkapaññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati. vitakkapaññattiyā sati papañcasaññāsaṅkhā-samudācaraṇa-paññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati.

42390.meaning1: commentary on the Majjhima Nikāya compiled by Buddhaghosa

42391.meaning1: stilling of mental proliferation; subsiding of endless conceptualization

examples.text: channaṃ, āvuso, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā papañcanirodho papañcavūpasamo'ti.

42392.meaning1: enjoying various opinions; taking delight in proliferation; engaged in mental proliferation

examples.text: yo papañcam'anuyutto, papañc'ābhirato mago, virādhayī so nibbānaṃ, yogakkhemaṃ anuttaraṃ.
ākāse'va padaṃ n'atthi, samaṇo n'atthi bāhire, papañc'ābhiratā pajā, nippapañcā tathāgatā.

42393.meaning1: enjoying mental proliferation; taking pleasure in manifold ideas
42393.commentary: (MNa) ettha āraman'ti etthā'ti ārāmo. papañco ārāmo assā'ti papañc'ārāmo.

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu… saṅgaṇik'ārāmo hoti saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇik'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, saṃsagg'ārāmo hoti saṃsaggarato saṃsagg'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, papañc'ārāmo hoti papañcarato papañc'ārāmataṃ anuyutto.

sā pan'āvuso, niṭṭhā papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino udāhu nippapañc'ārāmassa nippapañcaratino'ti? sammā byākaramānā, bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ byākareyyuṃ, nippapañc'ārāmass'āvuso, sā niṭṭhā nippapañcaratino, na sā niṭṭhā papañc'ārāmassa papañcaratino'ti.

42394.meaning1: enjoyment of manifold ideas; pleasure of mental proliferation

examples.text: idh'āvuso, bhikkhu… saṅgaṇik'ārāmo hoti saṅgaṇikarato saṅgaṇik'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, saṃsagg'ārāmo hoti saṃsaggarato saṃsagg'ārāmataṃ anuyutto, papañc'ārāmo hoti papañcarato papañc'ārāmataṃ anuyutto.

42395.meaning1: proliferation; conceptualization; process of ever-expanding ideation
42395.commentary: (ADHa) māno hi iñjanato iñjitaṃ, maññanato maññitaṃ, phandanato phanditaṃ, papañcanato papañcitaṃ. tehi tehi kāraṇehi saṅkhatattā saṅkhatan'ti ca vuccati.

examples.text: papañcitaṃ, bhikkhave, rogo, papañcitaṃ gaṇḍo, papañcitaṃ sallaṃ. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, nippapañcena cetasā viharissāmā'ti, evañ'hi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabbaṃ.

42397.commentary: (DNa) appapañcaṃ papañcetī'ti na papañcetabbaṭṭhāne papañcaṃ karoti, anācaritabbaṃ maggaṃ carati.

examples.text: channaṃ, āvuso, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā atth'aññaṃ kiñcī'ti, iti vadaṃ appapañcaṃ papañceti.
yaṃ papañceti tatonidānaṃ purisaṃ papañcasaññāsaṅkhā samudācaranti atīt'ānāgatapaccuppannesu cakkhuviññeyyesu rūpesu
